lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Operating sequence from field record to financing. Four wheat contracts, the 2027 pool, Token-2022 WHEAT-2027 and one Devnet primary placement are proven on Solana Devnet. Minted 1,000; placed 10; 990 remain in Registrar inventory.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: This prototype shows how rights to future agricultural production can be digitally verified, pooled, risk-adjusted, tokenized and financed.
dashboard.infrastructureNote: Read-only Solana Devnet status. Eligible coverage remains the operating view. Token figures are secondary.
dashboard.regulatorIntro: Eligible coverage remains economically primary. Token supply is a secondary operating view.
dashboard.registrarIntro: WHEAT-2027 minted supply, Registrar inventory and the settled primary placement.
dashboard.producerIntro: Own fields, contracts and monitoring only.
dashboard.scasIntro: Attestation, matching and coverage source status. SCAS does not mint.
dashboard.investorIntro: Holdings are read from Solana Devnet. Coverage is the underlying agricultural capacity, not the holding.
dashboard.traderIntro: Market-facing instruments. Secondary market is not open.
dashboard.complianceIntro: Application-level participant screening. Provider results remain DEMO / SIMULATED except cryptographic wallet ownership.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Phase 4: ISS-001 minted 1,000 WHEAT-2027. One Devnet primary placement of 10 units is settled. 990 remain in Registrar inventory. Cap 8,300 t. The public app does not mint, burn or place.
tokens.hypothesis: Demo working hypothesis — not a legally approved term sheet. Partner answers on instrument type, issuer and redemption remain open.
tokens.claimBoundary: WHEAT-2027 is a Commodity Agricultural Token. The holder has a claim against the Issuer, not direct legal ownership of a farmer’s wheat, not a claim on an individual Producer, not farm equity, and not ownership of the underlying DAC.
tokens.issueTooltip: Minted tokens exist. The public app does not sign. Further minting stays with the Registrar.
tokens.burnTooltip: Burn is a Registrar action after redemption. The public app does not burn.
tokens.issueNote: Mint and burn are Registrar actions. They stay disabled in the public app. Administrative mint creation runs from a WSL script.
tokens.notDeployedNote: No Token-2022 mint, mint authority or issuance transaction is recorded.
tokens.supplyNotSold: Minted supply is not the same as tokens placed with investors. 1,000 minted does not mean 1,000 sold.
tokens.supplyIntro: Coverage capacity is the economic cap. Minted supply is the Token-2022 total. Placed and circulating change only after primary placement.
tokens.issuanceIntro: Technical Devnet placement demonstrator. Commercial placement is not publicly open.

mintProof.title: Token-2022 mint
mintProof.intro: Mint identity on Solana Devnet. On-chain supply is minted Token-2022 total, not tokens sold.
mintProof.foundIntro: Mint account exists. ISS-001 minted 1,000. Placement is separate. The public app does not mint.
mintProof.holdingNote: Registrar inventory is the unsold minted balance. Placed tokens are held by the investor after atomic DvP.

tokens.termsIntro: Commodity agricultural token. The holder’s claim is on the Issuer, not the farmer.
tokens.claimIssuer: Claim on the Issuer for delivery of wheat of the stated quality
tokens.redemptionGrain: Grain delivery by the Issuer (not a cash instrument in this programme)
tokens.financialNote: A financial agricultural token is not opened in this wheat programme. That instrument would pay money; the pool would be risk cover, not an automatic pledge.
tokens.capIntro: Minted commodity tokens cannot exceed attested eligible coverage. 1 token = 1 tonne.
tokens.deskIntro: Prepare a tranche against remaining capacity. Prepare does not mint. Mint stays disabled.
tokens.deskDemoNote: Demo only · session state · not persisted · not written to chain · not a Token-2022 mint.
tokens.preparedIntro: Reserved against the cap until cancelled. Prepare does not mint and does not place tokens with investors.
tokens.noPrepared: No tranche has been prepared in this session.
tokens.mintBlocked: Mint is blocked: Token-2022 is not deployed.

market.title: Market

market.instrumentIntro: Commodity Agricultural Token. Holder right: claim against the Issuer.
market.priceNote: Simulation Only · Not Commercial Terms. 100,000 DEMO-KZT per WHEAT-2027 is a technical demo value.
market.demoKztDisclaimer: DEMO-KZT is a DEMO SETTLEMENT ASSET with NO MONETARY VALUE. It is not a stablecoin, not tokenized KZT, not legal tender, and not a claim against a bank.
market.placementIntro: Read-only evidence for the controlled Devnet placement PL-ISS001-0001.

scas.title: SCAS Operator
scas.description: SCAS attests fields, digital agricultural contracts, monitoring, scoring, pool lock and coverage inputs. It matches Issuer and Producer into a digital agricultural contract. It does not mint, burn or match investment orders.
scas.boundary: Attestation is an SCAS operator action. Minting and primary placement are Registrar / Market actions. SCAS does not mint, burn, place tokens or hold investor funds.

role.scasValue: Attest contours, satellite, moisture, scores, pool lock, coverage snapshot
role.registrarValue: Registry, accounts, mint, inventory, placement authorization
role.issuanceValue: Registrar minted 1,000 WHEAT-2027. Placement is a Market programme action, not SCAS.

scas.fieldBookIntro: Four wheat contracts attested and locked into POOL-WHEAT-2027-01. The same volume cannot back another issue.
scas.queueIntro: Operator review of field and monitoring evidence. Approve attests a fact. Reject does not mint or burn.
scas.queueDemoNote: Demo only · session state · not persisted · not written to chain · not sent to the Registrar.
scas.rejectPlaceholder: Comment for the producer or issuer
scas.payloadIntro: What SCAS would send over API before any issuance. The Registrar still decides whether to mint.
scas.issuanceIntro: Mint and burn stay with the Registrar after SCAS attestation. They are disabled in this demo.
scas.mintTooltip: SCAS does not mint. Token issuance is a Registrar action.
scas.burnTooltip: SCAS does not burn. No tokens are in circulation.
